D: A family Christmas goes so badly that a young boy's lost spirit summons the dark shadow of St. Nicholas.
P: Serve the gingerbread when the gingerbread men come to life.
S: Omi's pretzels with obatzda cheese dip
Soft baked pretzels with a creamy camembert and paprika dip

Warm salted soft pretzels with obatzda, a punchy Bavarian dip of camembert, butter, paprika, caraway and beer, plus pickles for crunch. Roll 500g pizza dough into 8 ropes and twist into pretzels. Dip each in 2L simmering water with 60g bicarb for 30 seconds. Brush with egg, sprinkle with sea salt flakes and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Mash 200g ripe camembert with 50g soft butter, 50g cream cheese, 2 tbsp lager, 1 tsp sweet paprika, 1/2 tsp caraway seeds and finely diced red onion. Serve the pretzels warm with the dip and cornichons.
Slow-cooked onion dip with sour cream

Deeply caramelised onion dip with sour cream and chives, topped with crispy fried shallots and served with kettle chips. Slowly cook 3 thinly sliced brown onions in 30g butter and 1 tbsp oil over low heat for 35 minutes until jammy and deep brown. Add 1 tsp Worcestershire and a splash of water and scrape the pan, then cool. Mix with 250g sour cream, 100g cream cheese, 2 tbsp chopped chives and salt. Chill 30 minutes. Top with 3 tbsp crispy fried shallots and more chives and serve with 200g kettle chips.
M: Beef mince and tomato lasagne layered with white sauce
Beef lasagne with a bubbling cheesy top, comfort food for the night before everything goes wrong.
W: Spiced ginger cookies with piped icing teeth and red eyes

Dark, spicy gingerbread men with a pinch of chilli, piped with jagged white icing grins and red eyes, crisp at the edges and chewy inside. Melt 100g butter with 100g golden syrup and 80g dark brown sugar. Mix in 300g plain flour, 1 tsp bicarb, 2 tsp ground ginger, 1 tsp cinnamon, 1/4 tsp chilli powder and 1 egg to a soft dough. Chill 30 minutes. Roll to 5mm, cut gingerbread men and bake at 180C for 10 minutes. Cool. Mix 150g icing sugar with 1 tbsp water and pipe jagged teeth, then add red eyes with a little tinted icing.
K: Hot red wine and apple juice with cinnamon, clove and star anise

Red wine and cloudy apple juice warmed with cinnamon, cloves, star anise and orange, served steaming in mugs. Plain spiced apple for non-drinkers. Pour 750ml red wine and 500ml cloudy apple juice into a saucepan. Add 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves, 2 star anise and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes without letting it simmer. Ladle into mugs with an orange slice each. For non-drinkers, warm 1L apple juice with the same spices in a second pan.
